solution.title: Google Cloud Platform Landing Zone & Organization Foundation (Enterprise)

products.name: Google Cloud Platform Landing Zone & Organization Foundation (Enterprise) — Commercial
products.short_description: Build an enterprise Google Cloud landing zone — resource hierarchy, org policies, least-privilege IAM baseline, centralized logging, shared network, naming/labeling — the governed foundation every GCP workload lands on. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stand up an enterprise-grade Google Cloud foundation the right way

Moving real workloads to Google Cloud Platform without a foundation creates sprawl, inconsistent security, and cost you can't attribute. This solution builds the landing zone: the resource hierarchy (Organization → folders → projects), org policies, a least-privilege IAM baseline, centralized logging/monitoring, a shared network pattern, and naming/labeling — the secure, governed platform every later workload lands on.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the landing-zone reference: resource hierarchy, org policies, IAM baseline, logging/billing/network shape, and the Assess→Design→Configure→Pilot→Validate→Expand model.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Organization, org-admin access, billing, gcloud/IaC toolchain, hierarchy & naming design).
  • Implementation Guide — build the folder/project hierarchy, apply org-policy guardrails, set the IAM baseline and groups, wire centralized audit logging + billing export, and stand up the shared-network landing pattern — pilot-first, each artifact named.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (hierarchy, guardrails enforced, logging flowing) plus Best Practices for extending the landing zone as workloads onboard.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A secure, governed Google Cloud foundation — hierarchy, guardrails, IAM, logging, and network in place — so every workload lands consistent, attributable, and compliant.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • gcp_hierarchy_provisioner.py — create the landing-zone folder/project hierarchy from a plan
    • gcp_landing_zone_validate.py — validate the landing-zone gates and emit an HTML report
    • gcp_naming_label_helper.py — emit and validate the landing-zone naming/labeling standard
    • gcp_org_assessment.py — read-only inventory of a Google Cloud Organization's foundation state
    • gcp_org_policy_guardrails.py — apply the "Org Policy Baseline - Org - v1" guardrail set to a scope

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
